[Council File 26-1444]
Motion (Jurado – Rodriguez) relative to including one Animal Control Officer position and one Management Analyst position dedicated to the Skid Row community in the Department of Animal Services’ Fiscal Year 2027-28 budget proposal. (This matter is also referred to the Budget and Finance Committee.)

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee action: Approved: Approved Motion (Jurado - Rodriguez) dated 10-9-26 (Nov 4, 2026)
